defective_pattern: Sequencing subscales before their composite total scores in statistical variable definitions, correlation matrices, and descriptive tables.
why_defective: Violates the structural hierarchy of psychometric constructs and introduces cross-table mismatches between descriptive tables and correlation matrices.
observed_symptoms: Subscales listed before total scores in correlation matrices.
Cross-table sequence parity mismatch between descriptives and correlations.
validation-agent failing to detect sequence inversion due to blindspots.
corrective_remedy: Strictly index study variables such that Total Composite Scores precede subscales. Enforce programmatic cross-table structural parity assertions verifying correlation matrix variable sequences match descriptive table sequences.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect instances where subscale variables are sequenced before parent total scores.
